∀ (q : Units.{0} Complex),
  Not (IsOfFinOrder.{0} q) →
    ∀ (V : Type u_1) [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V]
      [inst_2 : Module.{0, u_1} (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.Uqsl2 q) V]
      [IsScalarTower.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.Uqsl2 q) V] [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_1} Complex V]
      [IsSimpleModule.{0, u_1} (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.Uqsl2 q) V],
      Exists.{u_1 + 1} fun v =>
        Exists.{1} fun ε =>
          And (Ne.{u_1 + 1} v 0)
            (And (Eq.{u_1 + 1} (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1} (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.e q) v) 0)
              (And (Eq.{1} (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} ε 2) 1)
                (Eq.{u_1 + 1} (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1} (Etingof.Problem2_16_5.K q) v)
                  (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1}
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} ε
                      (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (Units.val.{0} q)
                        (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (Module.finrank.{0, u_1} Complex V) 1)))
                    v))))
